```{r}
library(psych)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(glmnet)
library(readxl)
repo_root <- normalizePath("..")
```
```{r}
catonly = read_excel(file.path(repo_root, "data/processed/Category_Only_Recommendations.xlsx"))
dim(catonly)
names(catonly)
```

# Number of recommendation lists in each category
```{r}
denom <- catonly %>%
  count(category, name = "n_lists") %>%
  rename(Category=category)
dim(denom)
denom
```

# Convert recommendations to long form
```{r}
catlong <- catonly %>%
  mutate(list_id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = brand_key_1:brand_key_5,
    names_to = "rankvar",
    values_to = "Key"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = as.integer(str_extract(rankvar, "\\d+$")),
    Key = na_if(trimws(Key), "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Key)) %>%
  
  # In case the same canonical brand somehow appears twice in one list,
  # retain only its highest-ranked occurrence
  arrange(list_id, rank) %>%
  distinct(list_id, Key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(category, replicate, Key, rank)
dim(catlong)
names(catlong)
head(catlong)
```

```{r}
brandstats <- catlong %>%
  group_by(Key) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rec = n(),
    rr_sum = sum(1 / rank),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
dim(brandstats)
names(brandstats)
head(brandstats)
all = read.csv(file.path(repo_root, "data/marketplace/all_new_googletrends_wikipedia.csv")) %>%
  select(Key, Category, Brand, BrandShort, 
         Meaningful, Different, Salient, DemandPower, PricingPower,
         logAdSpend, logWiki, logNews, logSearch, logBrandwatch)
dim(all)
describe(all)
all %>% distinct(Key) %>% count() # confirmed pk
```


```{r}
catmetrics <- all %>%
  left_join(brandstats, by = "Key") %>%
  left_join(denom, by = "Category") %>%
  mutate(
    n_rec = coalesce(n_rec, 0L),
    rr_sum = coalesce(rr_sum, 0),
    BRP5 = n_rec / n_lists,
    MRR = rr_sum / n_lists
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(
    BRP5 >= .25 |  (BRP5<0.05 & logSearch >= 4),
    Brand, NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category, desc(BRP5), logSearch)
dim(catmetrics)
head(catmetrics)
describe(catmetrics)
```

```{r}
catmetrics %>%
  ggplot(aes(logSearch, y = BRP5)) +
  geom_point() +
  #geom_text_repel(aes(label = BrandShort), cex = 1.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(catmetrics, BrandShort %in% label_brands), 
      aes(label=BrandShort), size=1.7, max.overlaps=Inf, na.rm=TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Category) +
  labs(x = "log(Search)", y = "Brand recommendation probability (BRP@5)") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=8), 
        axis.title.x=element_text(size=8))
```


```{r}
catmetrics %>%
  ggplot(aes(logSearch, y = MRR)) +
  geom_point() +
  #  geom_text_repel(aes(label = BrandShort), cex = 1.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(catmetrics, BrandShort %in% label_brands), 
                  aes(label=BrandShort), size=1.7, max.overlaps=Inf, na.rm=TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Category) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=8), 
        axis.title.x=element_text(size=8)) +
  labs(x = "log(Search)", y = "Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR)")
```

```{r}
catmetrics %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_Search_MRR = cor(logSearch, MRR, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor_brandwatch = cor(logBrandwatch, MRR, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor_owned = cor(logAdSpend, MRR, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor_earned = cor(logNews, MRR, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor_Wiki = cor(logWiki, MRR, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor_salient = cor(Salient, MRR, use = "complete.obs")
  )
```
